poemReplay.note: Heard, not seen: what a screen reader calls the area where the poem is replayed.

timeline.note: Heard, not seen: the slider under the poem that moves through its drafts. The reader's guide names it in bold, so change it there too.

jumpTo.note: Heard, not seen: a mark on the timeline where a draft begins. {draft} is that draft's name, from the poem. The reader's guide refers to these marks.

skipToStart.note: The button that goes back to the poem's first moment. The reader's guide names it in bold, so change it there too.

skipToEnd.note: The button that goes to the finished poem. The reader's guide names it in bold, so change it there too.

play.note: The play button while the poem is stopped. The reader's guide names it in bold, so change it there too.

pause.note: The same button while the poem is playing. The reader's guide names it in bold, so change it there too.

playbackSpeed.note: The button that opens the speed slider. The reader's guide names it in bold, so change it there too.

playbackSpeedControls.note: Heard, not seen: the small panel the speed button opens.

playbackFrameRate.note: Heard, not seen: the slider inside that panel.

framesPerSecond.note: Heard, not seen: what a screen reader says as the speed slider moves. {fps} is a number such as 16.7.

fpsShort.note: Shown under the speed slider. {fps} is a number such as 16.7. Keep it short: the panel is narrow.

editTimeUnavailable.note: Shown under the timeline, in place of a date, when a poem did not record when this moment was written. Lower case, because it sits where a date would.
